> (auto generated by Claude)

Supersedes #45402, moved to a branch in this repository so the workflow can be run before merging.

Adds the release workflow for `sgl-flash-mla`, the wheel built from [sgl-project/FlashMLA](https://github.com/sgl-project/FlashMLA) (the SGLang fork of deepseek-ai/FlashMLA).

**Scope: release plumbing only.** Nothing in the framework consumes the wheel yet -- no AOT kernel changes, no `pyproject.toml` dependency. Those come later, separately.

Paired with sgl-project/FlashMLA#19, which does the packaging on the other side (distribution name, `VERSION` file, metadata). The intended order is: merge that one, register the PyPI project, then merge this.

## Files

| file | what it does |
|---|---|
| `docker/sgl-flash-mla.Dockerfile` | build image, CUDA 13.4 + torch 2.14.1 |
| `scripts/build_sgl_flash_mla.sh` | build in container, retag, produce the PyPI variant |
| `scripts/rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh` | `linux_<arch>` -> `manylinux2014_<arch>`, add `+cu130` |
| `scripts/update_flashmla_whl_index.py` | PEP 503 index under `sgl-whl/cu130/sgl-flash-mla/` |
| `.github/workflows/release-whl-flashmla.yml` | build -> GPU tests -> publish |

Modelled on `release-whl-deepgemm.yml`. Three things differ, all because FlashMLA is an AOT-compiled extension rather than a JIT library.

**No Python matrix.** The wheel is `cp310-abi3`, and the extensions hold no CPython symbols at all — measured on the built wheel:

```
undefined CPython (Py*/_Py*) symbols:   0
undefined torch C++ mangled symbols:    0
undefined torch stable C shim:         68
```

Both register through `STABLE_TORCH_LIBRARY` during static initialisation and are loaded with `torch.ops.load_library`, not imported, so neither defines `PyInit_*`. One wheel per architecture serves CPython 3.10+.

**Built with CUDA 13.4, published as `+cu130`.** The kernels need nvcc >= 13.1 for `cvt` with `.scaled::n2::ue8m0`, and older toolkits emit suboptimal instructions, so the compiler is pinned to 13.4. The tag describes the runtime instead: the extensions link `libcudart.so.13` — SONAME carries only the major version — and call no cudart API newer than 13.0, so they load against the cu130 torch SGLang ships. Verified by loading the wheel under torch 2.10.0+cu128 as well.

**The test matrix splits by what each GPU can run.** The current kernels are sm_100a/sm_103a and the frozen pre-2026.09.30 ones (`tests/legacy/`) are sm_90a/sm_100a/sm_103a, so H200 runs the legacy suite (dense MLA decoding lives there and is the reason SM90 is built at all), while B200 and GB300 run both. Each test job removes the FlashMLA source package from its checkout, which would otherwise shadow the installed wheel, and asserts that `flash_mla` comes from the wheel; it then loads both extensions and resolves an op from each namespace, so a missing symbol surfaces there rather than at the first kernel launch.

The retag step also differs from DeepGEMM's: setuptools tags this wheel `cp310-abi3-linux_x86_64`, so only the platform part becomes manylinux2014 and the abi3 part is left alone.

## Checked locally

The build → retag → index chain was run end to end against a real wheel:

```
sgl_flash_mla-1.0.0-cp310-abi3-linux_x86_64.whl   (7.9 MB)
  -> sgl_flash_mla-1.0.0+cu130-cp310-abi3-manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
  -> sgl-whl/cu130/sgl-flash-mla/index.html  (with sha256)
```

The kernels themselves were verified on H200 (sm90) and GB300 (sm103a) at the FlashMLA commit this builds from.

## Before merging

Needs a **`SGL_FLASH_MLA_PYPI_TOKEN`** repository secret, and the `sgl-flash-mla` project registered on PyPI. `GH_PAT_FOR_WHL_RELEASE` already exists and is reused.

detail.title: [CI] flash-mla: Add the sgl-flash-mla release workflow

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,252 @@
+name: Release sgl-flash-mla
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      version:
+        description: "Wheel version (e.g. 1.0.0, 1.0.1rc0)"
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      branch:
+        description: "FlashMLA branch to build from (default: sgl)"
+        type: string
+        required: false
+        default: 'sgl'
+      validation_only:
+        description: "Build and test without publishing wheels"
+        type: boolean
+        required: false
+        default: false
+      skip_tests:
+        description: "Skip the GPU test suite (publishes untested wheels)"
+        type: boolean
+        required: false
+        default: false
+
+concurrency:
+  group: release-sgl-flash-mla-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  # The wheel pins this; it is also what the test jobs install.
+  # The extensions use PyTorch's stable C++ ABI and would load against any 2.10+,
+  # but a release is tested against one version.
+  TORCH_VER: "2.14.1"
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        # One wheel per architecture. No Python matrix: the wheel is abi3
+        # (cp310-abi3) and serves CPython 3.10+, so 3.12 only drives the build.
+        python-version: ["3.12"]
+        cuda-version: ["13.4"]
+        arch: [x86_64, aarch64]
+        include:
+          - arch: x86_64
+            runner: x64-kernel-build-node
+          - arch: aarch64
+            runner: arm-kernel-build-node
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Clean workspace (remove root-owned files from prior runs)
+        run: |
+          docker run --rm -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace" alpine:3 \
+            sh -c 'rm -rf /workspace/..?* /workspace/.[!.]* /workspace/*' || true
+
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Checkout FlashMLA
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: sgl-project/FlashMLA
+          ref: ${{ inputs.branch || 'sgl' }}
+          path: FlashMLA
+          submodules: recursive
+
+      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
+
+      - name: Set wheel version
+        run: |
+          echo -n "${{ inputs.version }}" > FlashMLA/flash_mla/VERSION
+          cat FlashMLA/flash_mla/VERSION
+
+      - name: Build wheel
+        run: |
+          chmod +x ./scripts/build_sgl_flash_mla.sh ./scripts/rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh
+          ./scripts/build_sgl_flash_mla.sh "${{ matrix.python-version }}" "${{ matrix.cuda-version }}" "${{ github.workspace }}/FlashMLA" "${{ matrix.arch }}"
+
+      - name: Upload artifacts
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: flashmla-wheel-${{ matrix.arch }}
+          path: FlashMLA/dist/*.whl
+
+      - name: Upload PyPI artifacts
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: flashmla-pypi-${{ matrix.arch }}
+          path: FlashMLA/dist-pypi/*.whl
+
+  test:
+    needs: build
+    if: ${{ !inputs.skip_tests }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        include:
+          # SM90 runs only the frozen kernels: the current ones are sm_100a/sm_103a.
+          # The frozen ones are built for sm_90a/sm_100a/sm_103a, so SM100 runs both.
+          - arch_label: sm90
+            runner: 8-gpu-h200
+            wheel_arch: x86_64
+            tests: legacy
+            timeout: 90
+          - arch_label: sm100
+            runner: 8-gpu-b200
+            wheel_arch: x86_64
+            tests: current legacy
+            timeout: 180
+          - arch_label: sm103-aarch64
+            runner: 4-gpu-gb300
+            wheel_arch: aarch64
+            tests: current legacy
+            timeout: 180
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Checkout FlashMLA
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: sgl-project/FlashMLA
+          ref: ${{ inputs.branch || 'sgl' }}
+          path: FlashMLA
+          submodules: recursive
+
+      # The tests need only tests/. The source package would shadow the installed
+      # wheel (its directory has no built extensions), so it is removed.
+      - name: Remove the FlashMLA source package
+        run: rm -rf FlashMLA/flash_mla
+
+      - name: Download wheel
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          path: dist/
+          merge-multiple: true
+          pattern: flashmla-wheel-${{ matrix.wheel_arch }}
+
+      - name: Install wheel and deps
+        run: |
+          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          python3 -m pip install "torch==${TORCH_VER}" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 --force-reinstall
+          python3 -m pip install numpy einops rich pytest
+          # --force-reinstall: a base image may already carry this version, in
+          # which case pip skips the wheel and the job tests a stale extension.
+          python3 -m pip install dist/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps
+          # Both extensions register through STABLE_TORCH_LIBRARY at dlopen time,
+          # so a missing symbol surfaces here rather than at the first launch.
+          python3 -c "
+          import flash_mla
+          from flash_mla._loader import get_ops
+          print('flash_mla:', flash_mla.__file__)
+          import os
+          assert not flash_mla.__file__.startswith(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']), 'not the installed wheel'
+          print('version:', flash_mla.__version__)
+          print('has_legacy:', flash_mla.has_legacy())
+          assert get_ops(use_legacy=False).sparse_decode_fwd is not None
+          assert get_ops(use_legacy=True).dense_decode_fwd is not None
+          "
+
+      - name: Run tests (current kernels)
+        if: contains(matrix.tests, 'current')
+        working-directory: FlashMLA
+        env:
+          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/FlashMLA/tests
+        run: |
+          python3 -c "import os, flash_mla; assert not flash_mla.__file__.startswith(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']), flash_mla.__file__"
+          python3 tests/test-sparse-prefill.py
+          python3 tests/test-sparse-decode.py
+
+      - name: Run tests (frozen kernels)
+        if: contains(matrix.tests, 'legacy')
+        working-directory: FlashMLA
+        env:
+          # conftest.py only fixes sys.path under pytest; these are scripts.
+          PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/FlashMLA/tests
+        run: |
+          python3 -c "import os, flash_mla; assert not flash_mla.__file__.startswith(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE']), flash_mla.__file__"
+          python3 -m pytest tests/legacy/ -q
+          # Dense MLA decoding is SM90-only.
+          if [ "${{ matrix.arch_label }}" = sm90 ]; then
+            python3 tests/legacy/test_flash_mla_dense_decoding.py
+          fi
+          python3 tests/legacy/test_flash_mla_sparse_prefill.py
+          python3 tests/legacy/test_flash_mla_sparse_decoding.py
+          python3 tests/legacy/test_flash_mla_sparse_decoding_v32_bit_equal.py
+
+  release:
+    if: |
+      !cancelled() && !inputs.validation_only &&
+      needs.build.result == 'success' &&
+      (needs.test.result == 'success' || needs.test.result == 'skipped')
+    needs: [build, test]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Download artifacts
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          path: dist/
+          merge-multiple: true
+          pattern: flashmla-wheel-*
+
+      - name: Download PyPI artifacts
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          path: dist-pypi/
+          merge-multiple: true
+          pattern: flashmla-pypi-*
+
+      - name: Record that the GPU test suite was skipped
+        if: ${{ inputs.skip_tests }}
+        run: |
+          echo "Releasing v${{ inputs.version }} with the GPU test suite skipped." \
+            >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+
+      - name: Upload to PyPI
+        run: |
+          pip install --upgrade twine "packaging>=24.2"
+          python3 -m twine upload --skip-existing dist-pypi/* -u __token__ -p ${{ secrets.SGL_FLASH_MLA_PYPI_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Release
+        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
+        with:
+          tag_name: v${{ inputs.version }}
+          repository: sgl-project/whl
+          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_FOR_WHL_RELEASE }}
+          files: |
+            dist/*
+
+      - name: Clone wheel index
+        run: git clone https://oauth2:${WHL_TOKEN}@github.com/sgl-project/whl.git sgl-whl
+        env:
+          WHL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_FOR_WHL_RELEASE }}
+
+      - name: Update wheel index
+        run: python3 scripts/update_flashmla_whl_index.py --cuda 130
+
+      - name: Push wheel index
+        run: |
+          cd sgl-whl
+          git config --local user.name "sglang-bot"
+          git config --local user.email "sglangbot@gmail.com"
+          git add -A
+          git commit -m "update sgl-flash-mla whl index for v${{ inputs.version }}${{ inputs.skip_tests && ' (GPU tests skipped)' || '' }}"
+          git push

@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+ARG BASE_IMG=pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder
+# FlashMLA's kernels use `cvt` with `.scaled::n2::ue8m0`, which needs nvcc >= 13.1,
+# and older toolkits emit suboptimal instructions for them. Build with 13.4.
+ARG CUDA_VERSION=13.4
+
+FROM ${BASE_IMG}:cuda${CUDA_VERSION}
+
+ARG ARCH=x86_64
+ARG CUDA_VERSION=13.4
+ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.12
+ARG PYTHON_TAG=cp312-cp312
+ARG TORCH_VER=2.14.1
+ARG PIP_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://pypi.python.org/simple
+ARG PYTORCH_MIRROR=download.pytorch.org
+
+ENV PYTHON_ROOT_PATH=/opt/python/${PYTHON_TAG}
+ENV PATH=${PYTHON_ROOT_PATH}/bin:${PATH}
+
+RUN yum install -y --nogpgcheck git wget tar gcc gcc-c++ make \
+ && yum clean all && rm -rf /var/cache/yum
+
+# The build links -lcuda, which on a machine with no driver resolves against the
+# toolkit's stub.
+RUN set -eux; \
+    if [ "${ARCH}" = "aarch64" ]; then _LIB=sbsa; else _LIB="${ARCH}"; fi; \
+    mkdir -p /usr/lib/${ARCH}-linux-gnu/; \
+    ln -sf /usr/local/cuda-${CUDA_VERSION}/targets/${_LIB}-linux/lib/stubs/libcuda.so /usr/lib/${ARCH}-linux-gnu/libcuda.so
+
+# torch is needed at build time (setup.py imports it) and is what the wheel pins.
+# The CUDA minor version of this torch does not have to match CUDA_VERSION above:
+# the extensions link libcudart.so.13, whose SONAME carries only the major, and
+# use no API newer than 13.0.
+RUN --mount=type=cache,id=sgl-flash-mla-pip,target=/root/.cache/pip \
+    set -eux; \
+    ${PYTHON_ROOT_PATH}/bin/pip install torch==${TORCH_VER} --index-url https://${PYTORCH_MIRROR}/whl/cu130; \
+    ${PYTHON_ROOT_PATH}/bin/pip install --index-url ${PIP_DEFAULT_INDEX} \
+        ninja setuptools wheel build numpy

@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# Build the sgl-flash-mla wheel inside a CUDA-versioned container.
+#
+# Usage: build_sgl_flash_mla.sh <PYTHON_VERSION> <CUDA_VERSION> <FLASHMLA_SRC> [ARCH]
+#   PYTHON_VERSION: e.g. 3.12 -- only picks the interpreter that drives the build.
+#                   The wheel is abi3 and serves CPython 3.10+ whichever is used.
+#   CUDA_VERSION:   13.4
+#   FLASHMLA_SRC:   path to a checkout of sgl-project/FlashMLA (submodules included)
+#   ARCH:           x86_64 (default) or aarch64
+#
+# Writes:
+#   <FLASHMLA_SRC>/dist/      — wheel tagged +cu130 and manylinux2014
+#   <FLASHMLA_SRC>/dist-pypi/ — the same wheel with +cu130 stripped
+#                               (PyPI rejects local-version segments)
+#
+# On the two version numbers: the kernels are compiled by CUDA 13.4, because they
+# use `cvt` with `.scaled::n2::ue8m0` (nvcc >= 13.1) and older toolkits emit
+# suboptimal instructions for them. The +cu130 tag describes the *runtime* the
+# wheel is published for: the extensions link libcudart.so.13, whose SONAME
+# carries only the major version, and call no cudart API newer than 13.0, so a
+# 13.4-built wheel loads against the cu130 torch SGLang ships.
+set -ex
+
+if [ $# -lt 3 ]; then
+  echo "Usage: $0 <PYTHON_VERSION> <CUDA_VERSION> <FLASHMLA_SRC> [ARCH]"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+PYTHON_VERSION="$1"
+CUDA_VERSION="$2"
+FLASHMLA_SRC="$(cd "$3" && pwd)"
+ARCH="${4:-$(uname -i)}"
+
+case "${CUDA_VERSION}" in
+  13.4) CU_TAG=cu130 ;;
+  *)
+    echo "Unsupported CUDA_VERSION: ${CUDA_VERSION} (the kernels require 13.4)" >&2
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+esac
+
+if [ "${ARCH}" = "aarch64" ]; then
+  BASE_IMG="pytorch/manylinuxaarch64-builder"
+else
+  BASE_IMG="pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder"
+fi
+
+PY_TAG="cp${PYTHON_VERSION//.}-cp${PYTHON_VERSION//.}"
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
+DOCKERFILE="${REPO_ROOT}/docker/sgl-flash-mla.Dockerfile"
+RENAME_SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh"
+
+DEPS_TAG="sgl-flash-mla-deps:cuda${CUDA_VERSION}-${PY_TAG}-${ARCH}"
+
+echo "----------------------------------------"
+echo "PYTHON_VERSION: ${PYTHON_VERSION}"
+echo "CUDA_VERSION:   ${CUDA_VERSION}"
+echo "CU_TAG:         ${CU_TAG}"
+echo "ARCH:           ${ARCH}"
+echo "BASE_IMG:       ${BASE_IMG}"
+echo "FLASHMLA_SRC:   ${FLASHMLA_SRC}"
+echo "----------------------------------------"
+
+docker build \
+  -f "${DOCKERFILE}" "$(dirname "${DOCKERFILE}")" \
+  --build-arg BASE_IMG="${BASE_IMG}" \
+  --build-arg CUDA_VERSION="${CUDA_VERSION}" \
+  --build-arg ARCH="${ARCH}" \
+  --build-arg PYTHON_VERSION="${PYTHON_VERSION}" \
+  --build-arg PYTHON_TAG="${PY_TAG}" \
+  -t "${DEPS_TAG}" \
+  --network=host
+
+mkdir -p "${FLASHMLA_SRC}/dist"
+
+# 1) Build. --no-build-isolation because setup.py imports torch, which the image
+#    provides; FlashMLA declares no PEP 518 build requirements.
+#    NVCC_THREADS defaults to 32 in setup.py; MAX_JOBS is what actually
+#    parallelises, and without ninja on PATH torch silently ignores it.
+docker run --rm \
+  --network=host \
+  -v "${FLASHMLA_SRC}:/flashmla" \
+  -w /flashmla \
+  -e MAX_JOBS="${MAX_JOBS:-$(nproc)}" \
+  "${DEPS_TAG}" \
+  bash -c 'set -eux; python3 setup.py bdist_wheel'
+
+# 2) Retag inside the same image, which has a working pip/wheel and can rewrite
+#    the root-owned files the build container just wrote.
+docker run --rm \
+  -v "${FLASHMLA_SRC}:/flashmla" \
+  -v "${RENAME_SCRIPT}:/rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh:ro" \
+  -w /flashmla \
+  "${DEPS_TAG}" \
+  bash /rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh dist "${CU_TAG}" "${ARCH}"
+
+# 3) Sibling dist-pypi/ with the local version stripped.
+docker run --rm \
+  -v "${FLASHMLA_SRC}:/flashmla" \
+  -w /flashmla \
+  "${DEPS_TAG}" \
+  bash -c '
+set -eux
+mkdir -p dist-pypi
+for w in dist/*.whl; do
+  tmp=$(mktemp -d)
+  python3 -m wheel unpack "$w" --dest "$tmp"
+  unpacked=$(find "$tmp" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
+  info=$(find "$unpacked" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*.dist-info" | head -1)
+  meta="$info/METADATA"
+  orig=$(grep "^Version:" "$meta" | head -1 | sed "s/^Version:[[:space:]]*//")
+  new=$(echo "$orig" | sed "s/+cu[0-9]\+$//")
+  if [ "$orig" != "$new" ]; then
+    sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${new}/" "$meta"
+    old_base=$(basename "$info")
+    new_base="${old_base/${orig}/${new}}"
+    mv "$info" "$(dirname "$info")/${new_base}"
+  fi
+  python3 -m wheel pack "$unpacked" --dest-dir dist-pypi
+  rm -rf "$tmp"
+done
+ls -lh dist-pypi/
+'
+
+echo "Wheels in ${FLASHMLA_SRC}/dist:"
+ls -lh "${FLASHMLA_SRC}/dist"/*.whl 2>/dev/null || true
+echo "PyPI-ready wheels in ${FLASHMLA_SRC}/dist-pypi:"
+ls -lh "${FLASHMLA_SRC}/dist-pypi"/*.whl 2>/dev/null || true

@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Retag a freshly-built sgl-flash-mla wheel for the sgl-whl index.
+#
+# setuptools tags the extension wheel `cp310-abi3-linux_x86_64`. `linux_x86_64`
+# is not installable from an index -- pip and PyPI both reject it -- so the
+# platform becomes manylinux2014_<arch>, and the version gains the +cuXXX local
+# segment the index keys on.
+#
+# The abi3 tag is left alone: the extensions register through
+# STABLE_TORCH_LIBRARY and need no CPython API beyond the Limited API, so one
+# wheel really does serve CPython 3.10+.
+#
+# Input:  dist/sgl_flash_mla-<VERSION>-cp310-abi3-linux_<ARCH>.whl
+# Output: dist/sgl_flash_mla-<VERSION>+<CU_TAG>-cp310-abi3-manylinux2014_<ARCH>.whl
+#
+# Usage: rename_sgl_flash_mla_whl.sh <WHEEL_DIR> <CU_TAG> <ARCH>
+set -ex
+
+if [ $# -lt 3 ]; then
+  echo "Usage: $0 <WHEEL_DIR> <CU_TAG> <ARCH>"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+WHEEL_DIR="$1"
+CU_TAG="$2"
+ARCH="$3"
+PLAT_TAG="manylinux2014_${ARCH}"
+
+PYTHON="${PYTHON:-python3}"
+"${PYTHON}" -m pip install --quiet wheel
+
+shopt -s nullglob
+wheel_files=("${WHEEL_DIR}"/sgl_flash_mla-*.whl)
+if [ ${#wheel_files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
+  echo "No sgl_flash_mla wheel found under ${WHEEL_DIR}" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+for wheel in "${wheel_files[@]}"; do
+  TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
+  trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMPDIR"' ERR
+
+  "${PYTHON}" -m wheel unpack "$wheel" --dest "$TMPDIR"
+  UNPACKED=$(find "$TMPDIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)
+  DIST_INFO=$(find "$UNPACKED" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*.dist-info" | head -1)
+  WHEEL_META="${DIST_INFO}/WHEEL"
+  METADATA_FILE="${DIST_INFO}/METADATA"
+
+  # Only the platform part of the tag changes; the interpreter/ABI part stays abi3.
+  sed -i -E "s/^(Tag: [^-]+-[^-]+)-linux_${ARCH}$/\1-${PLAT_TAG}/" "$WHEEL_META"
+  grep -q "^Tag: .*-${PLAT_TAG}$" "$WHEEL_META" || {
+    echo "Failed to retag ${wheel}; WHEEL says:" >&2
+    cat "$WHEEL_META" >&2
+    exit 1
+  }
+
+  ORIG_VERSION=$(grep '^Version:' "$METADATA_FILE" | head -1 | sed 's/^Version:[[:space:]]*//')
+  if [[ "$ORIG_VERSION" == *"+${CU_TAG}"* ]]; then
+    NEW_VERSION="$ORIG_VERSION"
+  else
+    NEW_VERSION="${ORIG_VERSION}+${CU_TAG}"
+    sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${NEW_VERSION}/" "$METADATA_FILE"
+    OLD_BASE=$(basename "$DIST_INFO")
+    NEW_BASE="${OLD_BASE/${ORIG_VERSION}/${NEW_VERSION}}"
+    mv "$DIST_INFO" "${UNPACKED}/${NEW_BASE}"
+  fi
+
+  rm -f "$wheel"
+  "${PYTHON}" -m wheel pack "$UNPACKED" --dest-dir "$WHEEL_DIR"
+  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
+  trap - ERR
+done
+
+echo "Renamed wheels in ${WHEEL_DIR}:"
+ls -lh "${WHEEL_DIR}"/*.whl

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@ +# Generates a PEP 503 simple index for sgl-flash-mla wheels under +# sgl-whl/cu/sgl-flash-mla/index.html. Mirrors update_deepgemm_whl_index.py +# so consumers can `pip install sgl-flash-mla --extra-index-url https://...whl/cu130`. + +import argparse +import hashlib +import pathlib +import re + +SUPPORTED_CUDA_VERSIONS = ["130"] + + +def update_wheel_index(cuda_version, wheel_dir): + index_dir = pathlib.Path(f"sgl-whl/cu{cuda_version}/sgl-flash-mla") + index_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True) + base_url = "https://github.com/sgl-project/whl/releases/download" + + suffix = f"+cu{cuda_version}" + for path in sorted(pathlib.Path(wheel_dir).glob("*.whl")): + if suffix not in path.name: + continue + with open(path, "rb") as f: + sha256 = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest() + match = re.match(r"sgl_flash_mla-([0-9][^-+]*)(?:\+cu[0-9]+)?-", path.name) + if not match: + continue + ver = match.group(1) + full_url = f"{base_url}/v{ver}/{path.name}#sha256={sha256}" + with (index_dir / "index.html").open("a") as f: + f.write(f'{path.name}
\n') + + +def main(): + parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() + parser.add_argument( + "--cuda", type=str, required=True, choices=SUPPORTED_CUDA_VERSIONS + ) + parser.add_argument("--wheel-dir", type=str, default="dist") + args = parser.parse_args() + update_wheel_index(args.cuda, args.wheel_dir) + + +if __name__ == "__main__": + main()
